_comment: ESTIMATE ONLY. Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens and are read at runtime,
so a reviewer can correct them without touching code. Image generation on
the gpt-image-2.x family is billed per token, not per image, so any
'cost per image' figure is derived and approximate -- the ledger labels every
row it produces with is_estimate = true.
Tavily is billed in credits against a plan, not in dollars, so it is counted
in credits and deliberately left without a USD figure.
Source: published Azure OpenAI / OpenAI rate cards, September 2026.

search_credits._comment: Tavily: basic search = 1 credit, advanced = 2, extract = 1.
